name: clear_bits_and_wait
description: Clears the top bit of a global byte, then runs a 100-pass loop clearing bit three of that byte, and finally calls two other routines.

name: spin_countdown_3000
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from 3000 to zero with an empty loop, giving a fixed delay, then returns.

name: wait_until_status_bit_clear
description: Busy-waits while bit five of a global status byte stays set, then returns.

name: poll_status_bit_then_call
description: Loops while bit four of a global byte is set, forcing its low two bits to 11 and calling another routine on each pass, then returns.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return with no work, so it is an empty stub.

name: wait_then_step_and_delay
description: Waits while bit four of a global byte is set, then 79 times sets its low two bits to 01 and calls another routine, and finally spins a 15000-count delay.

name: step_low_bits_then_delay
description: Runs 79 passes that set the low two bits of a global byte to 01 and call another routine, then spins a 15000-count delay.

name: spin_countdown_15000
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from 15000 to zero with an empty loop, then returns.

name: write_registers_and_poll_status
description: Clears bit two of a global byte, writes control words and a longword into a register block, then polls a status word for bit one with a bound of 200000 iterations, recording a value and returning when it appears.

name: wait_for_flag_bit
description: Spins until bit four of a global byte becomes set, then returns.

name: store_four_flagged_words
description: Clears bit three of a global byte and sets its top bit, then stores four global words, each with its top bit set, at fixed offsets from a base register.

name: scan_buffer_for_sync_word
description: Scans a table of longwords bit by bit for a fixed 16-bit sync pattern; on a match it calls another routine repeatedly while a global flag stays nonzero, and if nothing matches it sets that flag to one.

name: loop_while_global_nonzero
description: Calls another routine repeatedly while a global byte is nonzero, then returns, with no other work.

name: find_sync_and_store_position
description: Scans longwords bit by bit for a fixed 16-bit sync pattern, counting positions; on a match it stores the count into the target address and sets a global flag to one, unless the target is that flag, which it clears instead. Without a match it clears the flag.

name: store_word_and_set_flag
description: If the target pointer does not refer to the global flag, stores the supplied word there and sets the flag to one; otherwise it clears the flag.

name: return_from_handler
description: A handler entry that only returns, with no work.

name: add_offsets_on_nonzero_result
description: Calls another routine that returns a 16-bit value and, when it is nonzero, adds fixed constants to two global values. Returns the register pair unchanged.

name: return_concatenated_registers
description: Calls another routine and returns the two register values it leaves as one 64-bit result.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: clip_and_blit_masked_tile
description: Clips a 16-pixel-wide rectangle against bounds held in global variables, then for each row shifts source words into position and combines them with a clip mask into the four bitplane destinations. Returns early when the rectangle lies entirely outside the bounds.

name: copy_rows_into_four_planes
description: Selects one of two pointer tables from a global flag, then copies source words into four destination planes row by row, advancing the source by a stride. The row count and offsets come from globals.

name: setup_blitter_params_and_wait
description: Computes a source and destination address from globals and writes blitter parameter registers, waiting for the blitter busy bit to clear between steps before writing a final size value.

name: run_blitter_row_loop
description: Sets blitter parameter registers, then for each row waits for the blitter busy bit to clear, writes two address values and a size value, and advances both addresses by a fixed step.

name: copy_planar_rows_with_stride
description: Copies words from a source table into four destination planes row by row, advancing both by fixed strides; a width check first calls another routine for oversized rows.

name: start_blitter_copy_and_wait
description: Programs the blitter control, mask and address registers from globals and a table value, waits for the busy bit to clear, then writes a size value built from the width and height and waits again.

name: setup_blit_when_flags_clear
description: If neither bit four nor bit five of a flags byte is set, programs the blitter mask and address registers and waits for the busy bit; otherwise it stores a computed offset into a global.

name: calculate_blt_window_bounds
description: Derives clipping limits for a window from a record and the global bounds, then fills a buffer row by row by looking up byte pairs in a table.

name: clamp_record_rectangle_to_bounds
description: Reads a position and size record, clamps its rectangle to the global clip bounds, and stores the clamped edges in globals; it then sets up per-row masks and calls other routines to finish the setup.

name: clip_record_rectangle_or_skip
description: Like the neighbouring record routine, but returns immediately when the record's first byte has its top bit set or its rectangle lies outside the clip bounds.

name: store_flag_for_matching_handler
description: When a global flag is zero and an address register matches one of four known handler addresses, stores the flag into the second word of that record; then calls another routine and returns.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Stores the global byte into the byte at offset one of an address register's target, then calls another routine and returns.

name: configure_audio_channel
description: Calls a library routine, then sets an audio channel's volume (capped at 100), pointer, length and period registers and marks the channel state before a final library call.

name: clear_channel_flag_if_negative
description: If a channel's flag byte has its top bit set, clears that flag and a second byte, then writes the channel's bit mask to a hardware control register.

name: dispatch_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Ands two interrupt status words and calls a routine for each of four bits that is set, then acknowledges the interrupt request register by writing a fixed mask.

name: decrement_channel_counter
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter for one channel; when it reaches zero, clears the channel's flag byte and writes the channel bit mask to a hardware control register.

name: execute_sequential_routines
description: Calls four other routines in sequence and returns.

name: forward_call_keep_registers
description: Calls another routine and passes the register pair through unchanged.

name: forward_call_from_handler
description: Entry for a handler pointer: calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_and_return_register_pair
description: Calls another routine, then returns the two register values it left, unchanged.

name: compute_scaled_seven_bit_value
description: Takes the low seven bits of an input value, multiplies them by eight, subtracts seven, and stores the result in a global.

name: forward_call_unreached
description: A single call to another routine with no other work, found in an area that decodes as code but is not reached from known entries.

name: set_audio_volume_capped
description: Clamps an input value to at most 100; non-negative values are written to the audio volume registers of the channels, while negative values are written to a single register.

name: store_word_into_record
description: Stores the low word of the input value into a record at a fixed offset from an address register, then returns.

name: program_audio_channel_registers
description: Writes an audio channel's pointer, length, period and volume registers, then enables the channel's DMA when the input is nonnegative and disables it otherwise.

name: write_two_fixed_control_words
description: Writes two fixed control words into hardware register slots of a record, one clearing and one setting a channel bit, then returns.

name: setup_audio_interrupt_state
description: Saves its inputs, calls a library routine, resets a block of global words, stores an interrupt handler address in an interrupt structure, configures the CIA timer control, and makes a final library call.

name: dispatch_audio_sequence_state
description: Does nothing while a stored counter is zero; otherwise it dispatches on the input value: zero ends the sequence and clears the channel's control bits, a positive value clears the counter's high part and reprograms the channel, and a negative value reloads the channel.

name: dispatch_audio_state_direct
description: Dispatches on the input value without the counter check: a negative value sets a timer reload and clears a counter, zero ends the sequence and clears the channel's control bits, and a positive value reprograms the channel's timing registers.

name: set_registers_and_reload_value
description: Writes two fixed control words and a zero to hardware registers, clears a flag, then reloads a stored value.

name: clear_flags_and_write_controls
description: Clears a flag byte and a CIA control bit, then writes two control words and a value of seven to globals, and returns.

name: set_control_bits_when_flagged
description: When a global flag is nonzero, stores a handler address and writes two control words; when the flag is still nonzero, sets a control bit in a CIA record and sets bits in a global.

name: dispatch_interrupt_channel_handlers
description: When a status bit is set, calls one of four handler addresses for each request bit that is set in the masked interrupt word, then returns the register pair unchanged.

name: dispatch_three_channel_handlers
description: Calls the handler for each of three request bits that is set in the input word, with no other work.

name: dispatch_two_channel_handlers
description: Calls the handler for each of two request bits, bits seven and nine, that is set in the input word.

name: dispatch_single_channel_handler
description: Calls one handler when bit nine of the input word is set, otherwise returns.

name: dispatch_masked_interrupt_handlers
description: Masks two status words down to four request bits and, for each bit that is set, calls the matching handler; it does nothing when no masked bit is set.

name: install_interrupt_handler_block
description: Overlapping fragment that decodes as a separate routine: writes two control words to globals, stores a handler address into a record's hardware slot, clears a stored address, and stores a handler address in an interrupt structure.

name: install_interrupt_handler_block
description: Overlapping fragment with the same body as its neighbours: writes two control words to globals, stores a handler address into a record's hardware slot, clears a stored address, and stores a handler address in an interrupt structure.

name: install_interrupt_handler_block
description: Overlapping fragment with the same body as its neighbours: writes two control words to globals, stores a handler address into a record's hardware slot, clears a stored address, and stores a handler address in an interrupt structure.

name: install_interrupt_handler_block
description: Overlapping fragment with the same body as its neighbours: writes two control words to globals, stores a handler address into a record's hardware slot, clears a stored address, and stores a handler address in an interrupt structure.

name: install_interrupt_handler_block
description: Overlapping fragment with the same body as its neighbours: writes two control words to globals, stores a handler address into a record's hardware slot, clears a stored address, and stores a handler address in an interrupt structure.

name: install_interrupt_handler_block
description: Overlapping fragment with the same body as its neighbours: writes two control words to globals, stores a handler address into a record's hardware slot, clears a stored address, and stores a handler address in an interrupt structure.

name: install_interrupt_handler_block
description: Overlapping fragment with the same body as its neighbours: writes two control words to globals, stores a handler address into a record's hardware slot, clears a stored address, and stores a handler address in an interrupt structure.

name: initialize_timer_and_pointers
description: Writes timer register values to globals, stores a handler address and a pointer into records, and returns.

name: advance_sound_sequence_step
description: Subtracts an input value from a timing counter and, when it expires, reads the next command bytes from a sequence stream and dispatches on the command type, which can write audio channel registers and set timing.

name: dispatch_sequence_command
description: Reads the next command byte from a sequence stream and dispatches on its type, with several command types writing audio channel registers.

name: read_sequence_until_timed_command
description: Clears a timing counter and reads sequence bytes in a loop, dispatching each command, until a command that sets a timed wait is reached, then returns.

name: run_sequence_commands_loop
description: Dispatches sequence commands from a stream in a loop, writing audio channel address, length and period registers for sample commands, until a command ends the loop.

name: read_commands_until_timed_wait
description: Resets the pending command each pass and reads sequence bytes, dispatching them until a command sets a timed wait, then returns.

name: store_timed_wait_and_pointer
description: Stores a timing value taken from the input byte minus 128 and the stream pointer into globals, adds four to a counter, and stores a handler address, then returns.

name: copy_entry_then_read_commands
description: Copies a word and a longword from a table entry indexed by a stream byte into globals, then reads and dispatches the next sequence commands.

name: start_sample_on_channel
description: Looks up a sample record for a channel index and, when its length is nonzero, writes the channel's pointer, length and period registers, then reads and dispatches sequence commands.

name: store_table_word_read_commands
description: Stores a table word into a record at a fixed negative offset, then reads and dispatches sequence commands in a loop.

name: dispatch_sample_channel_commands
description: Loops over sequence commands; for each sample command it writes the channel's pointer, length, period and volume registers from a table, and skips commands whose flag byte is zero.

name: or_table_mask_read_commands
description: ORs a table value into two global words, then reads and dispatches sequence commands from the stream.

name: skip_two_bytes_read_commands
description: Advances the sequence stream by two bytes and then reads and dispatches sequence commands.

name: set_bit0_pointer_and_width
description: If bit zero of a flags byte is set, computes a sample length and stores it with its pointer in the record's first channel slots, and in either case sets a flag word to 128.

name: set_bit0_handler_and_mask
description: If bit zero of a flags byte is set, stores a handler address in a global, then sets a record mask word to 128.

name: set_mode1_and_masks
description: Sets a mode word to one and two mask words to 128 in a record, then returns.

name: set_bit1_pointer_and_width
description: If bit one of a flags byte is set, computes a sample length and stores it with its pointer in the record's second channel slots, and in either case sets a flag word to 256.

name: set_bit1_handler_and_mask
description: If bit one of a flags byte is set, stores a handler address in a global, then sets a record mask word to 256.

name: set_mode2_and_masks
description: Sets a mode word to two and two mask words to 256 in a record, then returns.

name: set_bit2_pointer_and_width
description: If bit two of a flags byte is set, computes a sample length and stores it with its pointer in the record's third channel slots, and in either case sets a flag word to 512.

name: set_bit2_handler_and_mask
description: If bit two of a flags byte is set, stores a handler address in a global, then sets a record mask word to 512.

name: set_mode4_and_masks
description: Sets a mode word to four and two mask words to 512 in a record, then returns.

name: decrement_counter_set_bit3_mode
description: If bit three of a flags byte is set and a counter decremented by one goes negative, sets a mode word to eight and a mask word to 1024; in either case it sets a mask word to 1024.

name: return_empty_entry
description: A single return with no work, so it is an empty entry.

name: stub_undecompiled_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code could not be produced; only its callers and the instruction count are known.

name: stub_undecompiled_mul_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code could not be produced; its address is referenced by a multiply instruction and it has two callers.

name: stub_undecompiled_addq_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code could not be produced; its address is referenced by an add-quick instruction and it has one caller.

name: stub_undecompiled_clear_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code could not be produced; the facts show only a clear-style address reference and three callers.

name: stub_undecompiled_or_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code could not be produced; the facts show only an OR-style address reference and three callers.

name: stub_undecompiled_move_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code could not be produced; the facts show only move-style address references and six callers.

name: stub_undecompiled_store_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code could not be produced; the facts show only move and move-address references and five callers.

name: walk_records_and_init_globals
description: Stores several handler and global addresses into globals, calls three routines, then walks a linked list of records, calling another routine for each record whose flag byte is negative and whose pointed-to field is nonzero.

name: dispatch_through_offset_table
description: Reads a byte from a stream pointer, doubles it, and calls the routine whose offset is stored at that index in a table relative to a base register, then returns.

name: read_three_bytes_advance_pointer
description: Reads three bytes from a stream pointer, stores the pointer advanced by three in a frame slot, and returns the three bytes.

name: read_three_bytes
description: Returns the next three bytes at a stream pointer without advancing it.

name: read_three_bytes_when_zero
description: When a register word is zero, returns the next three bytes at a stream pointer; otherwise this fragment falls through without a return value.

name: interpret_stream_opcodes
description: Switches on an opcode byte from a stream and performs the matching action, such as storing a word or byte into a record slot, copying a null-terminated string, or returning a decoded operand; most opcode values are not decoded.

name: interpret_opcode_stream_entry
description: Alternate entry into the same opcode interpreter: switches on an opcode byte from a stream and performs the matching store, copy or return action; most opcode values are not decoded.

name: dispatch_via_second_offset_table
description: Reads a byte from a stream pointer and calls the routine whose 16-bit offset is stored at that index in a table relative to a second base register, then returns.

name: set_global_from_function
description: Calls a routine, then if an input word is zero takes a value from another routine, replacing it with 100 when a flag is nonzero, and stores the result in a global.

name: store_record_header_and_copy
description: Sets a flag bit in a record table entry, stores a byte, copies 32 bytes from the input stream into the record, and calls routines depending on a counter.

name: store_byte_via_offset
description: Stores a byte from the input record into a table at a base taken from a global plus a stored offset plus one, then returns.

name: insert_into_linked_list
description: Sets a new entry's link to zero and appends it to the end of a singly linked list whose head is held in a global, or makes it the head when the list is empty.

name: calculate_cross_products
description: Computes three byte values as cross products of two three-component vectors stored in a record, writing each result back into the record.

name: call_then_store_byte
description: Calls another routine, then stores the input byte at a fixed negative frame offset, and returns.

name: compute_scaled_vector_offset
description: Computes three position differences against a stored vector, then, when a flag byte is nonnegative, scales the first difference by a shift and a division before calling another routine.

name: return_flagged_byte_or_input
description: Returns its input pair unchanged when a flag byte is negative; otherwise it returns the input with a byte from a fixed record offset in the low word.

name: clear_flag_and_return
description: Calls another routine repeatedly until a stored count reaches zero or the routine returns zero, then clears a global flag and returns.

name: traverse_and_update_linked_list
description: When a flag is clear, marks the entry as visited and links it after a previous entry or at the list head; otherwise it links the entry without marking it, then returns.

name: update_linked_list_node
description: Finds the predecessor of a list entry and redirects its next link past the entry, or updates the list head when the entry is first.

name: copy_two_words_to_globals
description: Copies the first two words at a pointer into two global words, then returns.

name: apply_coordinate_offset
description: Computes position deltas between a record and a stored origin, and if any delta is nonzero adds them to the position fields of every entry in a linked list.

name: offset_list_coordinates
description: Adds three offset words to the record's position fields and walks a linked list, marking each unflagged entry that has a nonnegative flag byte.

name: wait_and_update_record_tables
description: Calls routines depending on flag bytes, busy-waits on a status byte, and then updates record tables through several routine calls.

name: update_record_bounds_from_flags
description: Reads a record's flag words to set global flags, copies a rectangle's position and size into globals when a flag is set, and calls routines to finish the update.

name: write_to_table_offset
description: Calls routines, then writes a word from one table entry to another, stores a pair of longwords and a word from globals into the entry, and writes a flag byte.

name: copy_table_entry
description: Calls another routine, copies a word between two table entries, and stores the previous global index as a link in the entry before updating the global index.

name: write_table_entry_and_call
description: Calls two routines, writes a word, a longword pair and a flag byte into a table entry from globals, then calls two more routines.

name: initialize_global_bounds
description: Sets the four global bounds to their starting extremes so that later updates can shrink or grow them.

name: expand_global_bounds
description: For each set record, widens the four global bounds to include its position and its extent taken from a linked shape record.

name: update_linked_list
description: Walks a sorted linked list by coordinate fields, comparing each entry's position and flag bytes against a new entry to find where it belongs.

name: traverse_records_and_queue_visible
description: Walks a list of records, skipping any with a flag bit set, and for each one with a nonzero extent calls routines to test it and records the matches.

name: append_words_to_buffer
description: Writes four global words into a buffer, advancing the buffer pointer by four words, and calls another routine once the pointer has reached a fixed limit.

name: copy_table_block
description: Loops over a table of four-word entries, copying each entry's words into globals and calling another routine once per entry until the end address is reached.

name: clamp_rect_bounds
description: Returns early when a record's rectangle lies outside the global bounds; otherwise it clamps the rectangle's edges to the bounds and continues with the clipped values.

name: expand_rect_bounds
description: Tests a record's rectangle against stored limits and computes its extent from a shape record, updating the bounds fields for records that pass the test.

name: update_clipping_region
description: Captures the clip rectangle from a record and its shape extent into globals when a global flag is zero, then updates the clipping region fields for the record's entries.

name: copy_run_into_frame_buffer
description: Writes a byte, then copies a run of words from the input into a frame buffer at decreasing offsets, with the run length taken from the first input word.

name: return_empty_entry
description: A single return with no work, so it is an empty entry.

name: call_then_store_global_byte
description: Calls another routine, then stores the low byte of an input register into a global.

name: set_global_to_one
description: Calls another routine, then sets a global flag to one; the masked input value is computed first but overwritten.

name: update_global_pointers
description: Sets two global pointers to a base address plus the global byte multiplied by thirty-two.

name: reset_global_variable
description: Writes 255 then zero to a global and clears it again, leaving it at zero.

name: check_nibble_sum
description: Compares the sum of the low nibbles of two input words against fifteen, but both outcomes return without any effect.

name: compare_low_nibbles_conditionally
description: Compares the low nibbles of two input words and returns early for out-of-range differences; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: reconstruct_nibble_data
description: Loops over 64 pairs of table words, comparing their low nibbles and calling other routines where the two words differ.

name: copy_bytes_unless_flag_set
description: Calls another routine, returns early when a global mode value is 1, 3, 5 or 7, otherwise clears the mode and copies a counted run of bytes from the source into the destination.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: forward_call_fragment
description: Calls one other routine and returns; it is a fragment whose pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: dispatch_via_second_offset_table
description: Reads a byte from a stream pointer and calls the routine whose 16-bit offset is stored at that index in a table relative to a second base register, then returns.

name: return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return with no effect.

name: return_immediately
description: Contains only a return, with no effect.

name: forward_call_fragment
description: Calls one other routine and returns; it is a fragment whose pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: forward_call_fragment
description: Calls one other routine and returns; it is a fragment whose pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: compare_registers_not_equal
description: Calls another routine, then compares two input words for inequality, but both outcomes return without effect.

name: compare_registers_and_branch
description: Calls another routine, then compares two input words, with both outcomes returning without effect.

name: reset_table_on_condition
description: When a global flag is zero, calls another routine; otherwise returns without action.

name: branch_on_global_zero
description: When a global flag is zero, calls another routine; otherwise returns without action.

name: forward_call_fragment
description: Calls one other routine and returns; it is a fragment whose pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return with no effect.

name: return_immediately
description: Contains only a return, with no effect.

name: write_byte_at_offset
description: Writes the input byte at a frame offset given by the next stream word, then returns.

name: call_sequence_of_three_routines
description: Calls one routine, passes its result to a second routine, then calls a third routine and returns.

name: initialize_data_structures
description: Sets a record's width and height fields to fixed values, several global pointers and flags to initial values, and returns.

name: copy_name_and_set_suffix
description: Copies a null-terminated name into a buffer, finds the last dot, replaces the character after it with a letter chosen by a global flag, then calls other routines.

name: decode_run_length_stream
description: Sets a global byte to one, then decodes a run-length coded stream: a negative count repeats one routine call, while a positive count repeats another.

name: refill_when_pointer_exhausted
description: When the input pointer has reached a limit, calls another routine and resets the pointer to a stored address; otherwise does nothing.

name: write_byte_with_bounds_check
description: Writes the input byte at a computed position unless the position lies below a bound, in which case it returns without writing.

name: decode_packed_stream_block
description: Loops over a packed input stream, repeating runs when a count equals three, writing each decoded byte through a pointer into a buffer and calling other routines for each step.

name: compute_byte_difference
description: Returns the negated difference between two input bytes, calling another routine first when an address is at or past a limit.

name: invoke_and_return_pair
description: Calls another routine and returns the two register values it leaves, unchanged.

name: search_sorted_table
description: Binary-searches a sorted table of word keys for the input value, returning when it is found; the table is reached through a pointer array.

name: initialize_list_structure
description: Fills a block of six-byte list entries with their own offsets and zero values, then sets the list's first link and two global counters.

name: advance_pointer_and_walk_table
description: Advances a global pointer by an even-rounded input value, then walks a pointer table up to a limit, calling other routines for entries that fall within a range.

name: build_entries_until_limit
description: Computes a starting pointer from record fields and a global base, stores it into a table slot, then loops writing zeroed entry fields until a global limit is reached.

name: process_flag_bits_loop
description: Tests bits of an input word and, when they permit, loops calling routines and storing each result in a global, stopping on a negative result.

name: forward_call_fragment
description: Calls one other routine and returns; it is a fragment whose pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: retry_until_nonnegative
description: Calls one routine and, while its result is negative, calls another routine and tries again; returns when the result is nonnegative.

name: retry_until_nonnegative_global
description: Stores the result of one routine in a global and, while it is negative, calls another routine and retries; returns once it is nonnegative.

name: retry_global_until_nonnegative
description: Stores the result of one routine in a global and, while it is negative, calls another routine and retries; returns once it is nonnegative.

name: retry_call_until_nonnegative
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with the current register state, calling a second routine between attempts, until the first returns a nonnegative value.

name: update_channel_countdown_state
description: Sets a global counter to one, then decrements it and calls routines on the way, handling negative values with a separate call.

name: update_global_and_copy
description: Returns when a global is negative; when it is zero, calls another routine and sets two globals to minus one; otherwise it calls another routine, loads a value from an input byte, and counts the global down.

name: decrement_counter_and_clear_fields
description: Decrements a counter field in a record and, while it is nonzero, adds two fields together, clamps the sum to 32767 and stores it, then calls another routine.

name: call_four_routines_in_turn
description: Calls four other routines in sequence and returns.

name: clear_structure_fields
description: Sets five fields of a record to zero, then returns.

name: update_clamped_channel_state
description: Checks several global values and, when a counter is nonzero and a difference is nonnegative, decrements the counter and stores the difference; then calls routines and clears a global flag.

name: return_to_caller
description: Contains only a return with no effect.

name: stub_undecompiled_block
description: Seventeen-instruction routine whose pseudo-code could not be produced; only its single caller and instruction count are known.

name: stub_undecompiled_pair_entry
